title: German-Style Bruschetta
description: A twist on the classic Italian bruschetta, this German-inspired dish features toasted bread topped with fresh tomatoes, rich Italian cheese, and a hint of garlic.
instructions: 2. Slice the bread into 1-inch thick slices and place on a baking sheet.
3. Drizzle the bread with 2 tablespoons of rich butter and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
4. Bake the bread in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes or until toasted.
5. While the bread is baking, chop the tomatoes and garlic.
6. Remove the bread from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
7. Top the toasted bread with the chopped tomatoes, garlic, and Italian cheese.
8. Drizzle the remaining 2 tablespoons of rich butter over the top of the bread.
